modules.title: 文字和背景的明暗差别，够不够看得清

items.title: 正文 4.5:1
items.text: 要认真阅读的文字（标题、正文、按钮文字）和背景的比值至少 4.5 比 1，这是行业通用的 readability 门槛。

items.title: 辅助文字 3:1
items.text: 占位提示、图标、装饰性标签这类不承担阅读任务的，3:1 起步——再低就等同看不见。

modules.title: 它不是什么
modules.text: 对比度不是「颜色好不好看」——配色审美是另一回事，对比度只回答看得清看不清。它也不只看文字：图标、按钮边框、表单描线同样有门槛。深色模式要单独查一遍，别沿用浅色模式那档文字色。

lessonPractice.title: 深色模式上线后有人反馈「正文看着费眼」。下面哪个描述最可能定位到问题？

options.label: 检查正文文字的对比度到没到 4.5:1
options.feedback: 对。深色模式最常见的翻车就是背景变黑了、文字还是原来那档灰，对比度掉到门槛以下。用比值说话，AI 才知道改到什么程度。

options.label: 把正文字号整体调大两个型号，让字更容易辨认
options.feedback: 字号变大只是让字更大，颜色差别没变的话还是费眼；先查对比度。

options.label: 给文字换成更亮的品牌色，让它在页面上更显眼
options.feedback: 换色不等于达标：亮色在黑底上可能够，在灰底上可能不够，还是要按比值检查。

en.title: After dark mode ships, someone says the body text strains their eyes. Which description most likely pinpoints the problem?

options.label: Check whether body text contrast reaches 4.5:1
options.feedback: Correct. The background turned black while the text kept its gray, dropping below the threshold. The ratio gives the AI a concrete target.

options.label: Bump the body font two sizes larger so words are easier to make out
options.feedback: Larger type stays hard to read if the color difference is unchanged; check contrast first.

options.label: Switch the text to a brighter brand color so it stands out more
options.feedback: A different color is not automatically compliant—bright may pass on black and fail on gray; verify by ratio.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 把页面上对比度不足的文字修一遍：要读的文字和背景至少 4.5:1，大标题和图标至少 3:1，深色模式下重新检查一遍。改完列一下哪些地方改了颜色。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Fix the low-contrast text on the page: readable text versus background at least 4.5:1, large headlines and icons at least 3:1, and re-check in dark mode. List which colors you changed.

learning.assumes: You have struggled to read a phone screen in sunlight.
learning.outcome: You can turn "hard to read" into a contrast requirement (4.5:1 for body) and know to re-check dark mode.

items.title: Readable text 4.5:1
items.text: Headings, body, captions, button labels—everything meant for real reading needs at least 4.5:1 against its background.

items.title: Large text and icons 3:1
items.text: Big headlines, icons, and button borders that carry no paragraph-level reading duty start at 3:1—anything lower becomes invisible.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Contrast is not "do the colors look good"—aesthetics is a separate question; contrast only answers legibility. It covers more than text: icons, button borders, and form outlines have thresholds too. Re-check dark mode separately instead of reusing the light-mode text colors.

distinctions.label: Dark mode
distinctions.text: {c:dark-mode} flips the palette; {c:contrast} is what you re-check afterwards so text stays readable on the new background.

distinctions.label: Typography
distinctions.text: {c:typography} sizes and weights text for scanning; {c:contrast} decides whether that text is readable against its background at all.
